protocol: Doppler monitoring during 7–8-hour chamber exposures spanning 22,500–30,000 ft. The selected risk set had Spencer grade 3 or 4 and no DCS symptoms.
outcome_window: From high-grade detection to the end of exposure. Time of high grade and observation cadence unreported.
locator: Abstract 219, printed p. 481, Methods and Results
note: This subgroup is contained within the 215 reviewed exposures. Participant linkage and overlap with the other Brooks series are unresolved.
